note: The Democratic Republic of the Congo: nationals of Burundi, the Congo, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda and Zimbabwe enter without a visa for 90 days; Mauritians get a 7-day visa on arrival; everyone else applies for an e-Visa (USD 300, and USD 90 at the border; 7 days, extendable in the country, not modelled). Tourist visas arranged through Virunga National Park aren't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries may enter the Democratic Republic of the Congo without a visa for up to 90 days: Burundi Congo Kenya Rwanda Tanzania Uganda Zimbabwe ... Citizens of Mauritius may obtain a visa on arrival valid for up to 7 days. ... Citizens of other countries may obtain an e-Visa for up to 7 days. ... The eVisa is usually processed within 72 hours and costs $300. An additional $90 must be paid at the point of entry.
